extracted.name: Cranberry Apple Pecan Quinoa Salad
extracted.description: This light-tasting cranberry apple pecan quinoa salad recipe features quinoa, cranberries, apples, and pecans in a Dijon mustard and cinnamon dressing.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 large crisp apple, chopped into small pieces
instruction_lines: Bring chicken broth and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until broth is absorbed, about 10 minutes. Off heat, fluff quinoa with a fork.
Whisk olive oil, Dijon mustard, maple syrup, and cinnamon together in a bowl; season with salt and black pepper.

Drizzle maple syrup dressing over quinoa; stir. Stir in apple, pecans, cranberries, and Parmesan cheese. Return cover to the saucepan; let mixture steam until dressing warms and apples slightly soften, 5 to 10 minutes.
